data.one_liner: Detect jailbreak/root, emulator, mock location and other safety flags on iOS/Android devices.
data.what_it_does: The plugin provides async methods to check if the device is jail‑broken/rooted, running on an emulator, using mock GPS, on external storage or in development mode. It also aggregates these checks into a single safety flag.
use_when: You need to block or warn users on compromised devices
You want to enforce security policies before allowing sensitive actions
avoid_when: Precise location tracking is required without extra permissions
False‑positive risk is unacceptable for your user base
strengths: Broad detection of jailbreak, root and many Android emulators
Configurable at startup to disable mock‑location checks
weaknesses: May produce false positives on some manufacturers
Requires location permission on Android for mock‑location detection
iOS mock‑location detection relies on jailbreak/emulator status
data.setup_notes: Add safe_device to pubspec, call SafeDevice.init (optional config), request location permission on Android for mock‑location checks, no extra native setup beyond standard plugin integration.
